package sqlc

const readIssueCoverageForUpdate = `-- name: ReadIssueCoverageForUpdate :many
SELECT ia.id, q.unit_id, q.value
FROM inventory_allocation ia
JOIN quantity q ON q.id = ia.quantity_id
WHERE ia.inventory_issue_id = ?
FOR UPDATE OF ia, q
`

const readReceiptAllocations = `-- name: ReadReceiptAllocations :many
SELECT ia.id, q.unit_id, q.value
FROM inventory_allocation ia
JOIN quantity q ON q.id = ia.quantity_id
WHERE ia.inventory_receipt_id = ?
FOR UPDATE
`

const getPermissionGroupsByIDs = `-- name: GetPermissionGroupsByIDs :many
SELECT permission_group.id
FROM permission_group
WHERE permission_group.id IN (/*SLICE:ids*/?)
`

const insertAllocation = `-- name: InsertAllocation :exec
INSERT INTO inventory_allocation (id, quantity_id) VALUES (?, ?)
`

// Not a statement, and must not be reported as one.
const tableName = "inventory_allocation"
